notes: Editable query is distinct from committed value; this variant rejects arbitrary new committed keys.
Filtering needs a query-aware results provider. The component does not itself supply every country dataset or filtering implementation.
Selected label completes the query on confirmation; inline completion during typing is not promised.
This existing listed-key variant is NOT the free-text address-writing aid described by the user. Do not infer that every autocomplete rejects unknown text.
For fixed-choice tasks prefer a defined separate-filter selector; use this variant only with an explicit reason and existing membership enforcement.
